$comment: The components the user chooses for (ApiAnalyzer). An API belongs to the first component whose match holds: assemblies (.NET Framework's), namespaces (and those under them), types (full names, without generic arity), members (Type.Member, any signature, or a documentation id). An API no component matches is its assembly's ("fw:System.Xml"). status: what is known that .NET's attributes do not say (Behavior: it works differently; Throws); force: the component's status whatever .NET has (an API that is not an API of .NET: a delegate's BeginInvoke). note: what it is, and what the converter does today.
$comment_throwingObsoletions: .NET's obsoletions whose members throw PlatformNotSupportedException (on every platform), not only warn.

throwingObsoletions.SYSLIB0006: Thread.Abort / ResetAbort: .NET はスレッドを中断できない
throwingObsoletions.SYSLIB0007: 暗号の既定の実装(引数なしの Create)
throwingObsoletions.SYSLIB0024: AppDomain の作成・アンロード
throwingObsoletions.SYSLIB0050: 書式設定子によるシリアル化の一部

$comment_options: What the user can choose for a component (component id -> its options; the default first or marked). The converter's rules name the option they belong to (rules/packages.json "option": "component:option"): a rule works when its option is chosen. planned: not there yet (shown, not chosen). A component with none has noneOption.
